title: Restorative Care Village Grand Opening Press Briefing 8/19/2026
description:
Los Angeles County officials and community partners celebrated the completion of Phases 4 and 5 of the Restorative Care Village at Los Angeles General Medical Center.

The new facilities expand access to mental health care, residential withdrawal management, and psychiatric services. Speakers highlighted the partnerships and years of work that helped bring the project to completion.
